facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports the NDPC launched investigations into over 1,000 educational institutions under the Nigeria Data Protection Act, giving them 21 days to produce 2024 compliance audit returns, a data protection officer and proof of registration; no decision is reported.
The NDPC investigates schools for compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act, with non-compliance exposing them to enforcement orders, administrative penalties or prosecution under the Act.

The NDPC, led by National Commissioner Dr Vincent Olatunji, launched a sector-by-sector compliance investigation of over 1,000 schools, with a joint working group with the Federal Ministry of Education.
